scope: Outcome-blind synthetic mutation audit using temporary fixtures only.
known_gaps: Firewall is hybrid denylist/static scanning, not a semantic schema allowlist.
Disguised protected-looking text fields can pass when their token is absent from the denylist.
Unexpected non-matching Parquet columns can pass the denylist schema check.
Artifact and packet verifiers bind hashes/shape but do not independently recompute producer formulas.
Lane/process checks cannot prove runtime access absence.
reopen_trigger: Introduce an explicit allowlist/semantic challenger or a new verifier version; do not use protected outcomes as fixtures.
